DESIGN PHILOSOPHY

Architectural Purity & Open Living

Positioned above road level within the secure 24-hour guarded gates of Izinga Park, uniting grand open-plan reception spaces with intimate family retreats.

A Contemporary Trophy Home Built for Entertaining

Discover exceptional luxury in the heart of Umhlanga Rocks with this 5-bedroom home, positioned above road level in the premier gated estate of Izinga Park. Every bedroom offers its own private en-suite bathroom, planned for privacy and family comfort.

Entertain in style with an expansive open-plan living area that flows effortlessly from the designer kitchen into the dining room, formal lounge, and outdoor entertainment terrace overlooking a sparkling swimming pool and manicured lawn.

Ascend to the upper level to discover a serene pyjama lounge alongside a dedicated cinema room ready for bespoke theatre configuration. With ducted air conditioning, an executive study, domestic quarters, and double automated garage, this home delivers complete modern family luxury.

Five En-Suite Bedrooms

Every bedroom boasts its own contemporary en-suite bathroom. The grand master suite includes a lavish walk-in dressing room, spa bath with freestanding soaking tub, and private balcony.

Direct Indoor-Outdoor Flow

Floor-to-ceiling architectural glazing opens from the living and dining rooms onto an expansive covered verandah, sparkling swimming pool, and private manicured lawn.

Cinema & Pyjama Lounge

A dedicated cinema room ready for custom media installation, paired with an upstairs pyjama lounge that provides a peaceful haven for family downtime away from formal guest areas.

Izinga Park Security

PRIVATE GATED COMMUNITY

Izinga Park · Umhlanga Prestige

Perched on the crest of Umhlanga Rocks, offering peaceful, family-focused estate living within moments of the coastline.

Private Security & Natural Surroundings

Izinga Park is celebrated as one of the most secure, family-focused gated estates in KwaZulu-Natal. Positioned on the high crest of Umhlanga, residents enjoy lush open green spaces, indigenous flora, and children's sports amenities protected by 24-hour perimeter security.

Located less than five minutes from the Umhlanga coastline, Gateway Theatre of Shopping, and top independent private schools, 40 Idwala Circle provides an enviable balance of private estate tranquillity and cosmopolitan city convenience.
